annotations.title: Look up a Supreme Court of Georgia opinion

description: One Supreme Court of Georgia opinion by docket in any case (S23A0421), reporter citation (317 Ga. 528, 883 S.E.2d 746), record id (a CourtListener cluster id, or ga- and the docket for a record read from the court's own website), or case name, as the same Markdown twin the site serves: frontmatter (cite_as, canonical_url, source_url, record_source, date, status), the verbatim opinion, then the summaries Georgia Commons wrote under a heading that says so. When several opinions share a docket this is the most recent and the frontmatter lists the others. `full` adds the summarized reasoning and the checked quotes. Returns at most `max_chars` characters (default 60,000); a longer opinion ends with the call for the next part.

full.description: Include the optional material the tool describes (for example votes and history, or the notes). Longer.
full.title: Full

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

opinion.description: The opinion: a docket number (S23A0421), a reporter citation (317 Ga. 528), a record id, or a case name.
opinion.title: Opinion

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start

name: opinions_lookup
title: Look up a Supreme Court of Georgia opinion
